Hardening the API

Four middleware additions to app.js — security headers, CORS, rate limiting, and request logging — none of them specific to this domain.

  • Security Headers with Helmet

    helmet() sets over a dozen safe-default response headers in one line — registered first, so every response gets them.

  • CORS

    Browsers block cross-origin requests by default — the cors middleware is what lets a frontend on a different origin actually call this API.

  • Rate Limiting

    Two express-rate-limit instances — a generous one on every route, a tight one on /auth — the same idea as Laravel's throttle middleware.

  • Request Logging

    morgan('dev') prints one line per request/response — the access log a running API needs and gets nothing like for free.
